name: Voxel Instancing
definition: A technique to repeat the same object many times in a scene by storing the object's model only once in memory and storing additional information (position and orientation) for each occurrence, reducing memory footprint and increasing rendering speed.
summary: Voxel instancing efficiently populates scenes with complex objects by reusing a single compressed voxel class across many GPU instances, avoiding the memory overhead of storing full grids for each occurrence.
